Why A.S. Dent Shop

The A.S. Dent Shop difference.

Lubbock's original dent shop

Owner Allen Scott trained in paintless dent removal in 1991 and opened the Slide Road shop in 1996.

Original paint, kept

No painting, no fillers. You keep the factory finish and the value of your car.

Insurance handled

We work with your adjuster on your behalf. A free loaner car comes with hail dent repair.

How it works

Back to like new in three steps.

01

Call or stop by

Get a free assessment at 3034 Slide Road. Tell us about the damage.

02

We handle the details

We work with your insurance adjuster and set you up with a loaner for hail repair.

03

Pick it up

We remove the dent and you drive away with your original factory paint.
